structure.unit: Provisions Relating to Accident and Sickness Insurance

law.catch_line: (Effective January 1, 2027) Carrier contracts; required provisions regarding prior authorization for drug benefits

text.section: As used in this section, unless the context requires a different meaning: "Carrier" has the same meaning as provided in subsection A of § 38.2-3407.15. "Prior authorization" means the approval process used by a carrier before certain drug benefits may be provided. "Provider contract" has the same meaning as provided in subsection A of § 38.2-3407.15. "Supplementation" means a request communicated by the carrier to the prescriber or his designee for additional information, limited to items specifically requested on the applicable prior authorization request, necessary to approve or deny such request.
The Commission shall have no jurisdiction to adjudicate individual controversies arising out of this section.

This section shall apply with respect to any contract between a carrier and a participating health care provider or its contracting agent that is entered into, amended, extended, or renewed on or after January 1, 2016.
